capabilities.title: Aggregates (IAggregateNode, IScreenAggregate)
capabilities.summary: An aggregate node in an action flow or a screen aggregate; children by raw verbs on the aggregate: IAliasedSource (args.dataSource), IFilter (args.condition), ISort, IJoin, IGroupByAttribute, aggregated column, ICalculatedAttribute. The compact `get` step covers where/sort/max. Direct native testing is a separate MCP operation: ssam_query_test describe/run with capture hash, query @key and explicit Test Values; it requires existing schema and does not validate app-user access.

route.operation: compact get {get, as, where, sort, max}; or create IAggregateNode|IScreenAggregate, its children, set, link

capabilities.guidance: Data access rules (kernel, both lanes): an aggregate or SQL inside a loop (ForEach body, or an If cycle that jumps back) is REFUSED with QUERY_IN_LOOP; fetch once before the loop with the related entity joined, e.g. {"get":"Order","as":"GetOrdersWithLines","sources":["OrderLine"],"joins":[{"left":"Order","right":"OrderLine","kind":"With or Without","condition":"OrderLine.OrderId = Order.Id"}]}, then look rows up by key inside the loop with ListFilter/ListIndexOf (escape only with allowQueryInLoop {why, at least 15 characters} on the op, recorded in the receipt). Two or more aggregates of the same flow or screen over the same entity or entities related by a reference attribute, used together, raise the HIGH warning AGGREGATES_MERGEABLE for semantic review only, without replacement operations: related sources do not prove equivalence of authorization, locks, intervening calls or writes, dependent filters, independent pagination/counts or join cardinality. Preserve the queries until those semantics are proved. A sort that is not dynamic is ONE attribute of a source (Source.Attribute) or one column of the aggregate, its direction only in desc / SortDirection Descending: X DESC, -X, IdentifierToLongInteger(X) and If(C, 0, 1) are written as that attribute with its direction and listed in expressionRewrites; any other expression is REFUSED with AGGREGATE_SORT_NOT_ATTRIBUTE (the OutSystems compiler fails on it at publish): add a calculated column with the expression and sort by the column, or write a dynamic sort (a Text expression with the ORDER BY). An aggregate that groups (group by or aggregated columns) sorts only by an attribute its group by reads (Source.Attribute, or a calculated column grouped by name), else AGGREGATE_SORT_NOT_ATTRIBUTE. Group by and aggregated columns over an expression are REFUSED with AGGREGATE_COLUMN_NOT_ATTRIBUTE: put the expression in a calculated column and group or aggregate it by name, e.g. {"calculated":[{"name":"TotalRow","value":"Line.Qty * Line.Price"}],"columns":[{"name":"Total","kind":"Sum","attribute":"TotalRow"}]}. Every group by or aggregated column names its attribute; Count counts the rows by the identifier of a source, e.g. {"name":"Rows","kind":"Count","attribute":"Order.Id"} (text AGG Rows=Count(Order.Id)): Count() or an empty attribute is REFUSED with AGGREGATE_COLUMN_NOT_ATTRIBUTE (no data type, nothing to aggregate). Joins are Only With (Inner), With or Without (Left) or With (Full), between two different sources of the same aggregate; a Right join of two sources is written as the Left join with them swapped (listed), None, a source of another aggregate or a source in no join is REFUSED with AGGREGATE_JOIN_NOT_NATIVE. A base that already breaks these rules refuses every delivery on top of it (preexisting, with the raw ops that fix it when certain). Without group by read <Agg>.List.Current.<Entity>.<Attr>; with group by or aggregated columns read <Agg>.List.Current.<Column>; <Agg>.List.Length counts rows. Filters, sorts, joins and calculated columns run before group by and cite the source alias (the entity name). A filter citing an action input creates an implicit parameter. Widget binding is ui.*.

capabilities.title: AdvancedSQL (ISQLNode)
capabilities.summary: Compact `get` with sql:true, statement ({Entity}.[Attr], @Param) and params {type, value}; or raw ISQLNode + Statement, an input parameter (ISQLInputParameter) + DataType, ISQLOutput named List (args.entityOrStructure), argument <sql>/arg:<Param>. Preflight is not execution. Direct native testing: ssam_query_test describe/run, SELECT subset only, explicit Test Values independent of runtime Value, existing schema; status reconciles uncertain calls without replay.

route.operation: compact get with sql:true, statement ({E}.[A], @P) and params {P: {type, value}}; or raw ISQLNode

capabilities.guidance: Never inside a loop (QUERY_IN_LOOP refuses it): one SQL before the loop with IN or JOIN on the key of the iterated list, e.g. SELECT {OrderLine}.* FROM {OrderLine} WHERE {OrderLine}.[OrderId] IN (@OrderIds) with @OrderIds Expand Inline, or JOIN {Order} ON {Order}.[Id] = {OrderLine}.[OrderId], then ListFilter by key inside the loop. The output is named List: the result is <Name>.List; a field reads <Name>.List.Current.List.<Field>. Filter, sort and page inside the statement; max sets MaxRecords.
